articles.title: Americast - Americanswers… on 5 Live! Why is Lindsay Clancy’s mistrial dividing America? - BBC Sounds
articles.summary: And will Trump succeed in limiting mail-in voting before the midterms?
articles.body: And will Trump’s attempts to limit mail-in voting at the US Supreme Court succeed? The US president has made an urgent appeal, trying to change the rules over who can and can’t vote by mail before this November’s midterm elections, despite ballot papers being posted out in several states. In this episode, Sarah, Sumi and Marianna are answering your questions with Matt Chorley from 5 Live. We look at why Lindsay Clancy’s mistrial has become over-run with conspiracy theories, and what is likely to happen next. Clancy has admitted killing her three children, in one of America’s biggest murder trials, widely covered on US television and social media platforms. Plus, what credentials does Trump’s son in law Jared Kushner have when it comes to being a peace envoy, after his meetings with Presidents Zelensky and Putin this weekend? And how seriously should we take Trump’s proposals for a new Space Force uniform, with many people comparing the designs to those worn by Nazi SS officers. articles.title: Logitech has created a Stream Deck for Photoshop and Premiere Pro
articles.summary: Logitech has created a creative console for Photoshop and Premiere Pro. The Stream Deck-like hardware includes a keypad and a dialpad to speed up creative tasks.
articles.body: After acquiring Stream Deck rival Loupedeck last year, Logitech is launching a $199.99 MX Creative Console that’s designed to control Adobe Photoshop and Premiere Pro. The control panel includes a Stream Deck-like keypad and a dialpad that has an analog dial and plenty of buttons to speed up creative tasks. Logitech has created custom plugins for Adobe apps like Photoshop, Lightroom Classic, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Audition, and Illustrator for its MX Creative Console. In Premiere Pro you can use the dial to scrub through a timeline, and there are four buttons around the dial to activate functions like undo. There’s also a roller for navigation, allowing you to easily adjust the level of zoom on a Premiere Pro timeline for more precise edits. In Photoshop you can twist the main dial to adjust brush sizes, or zoom in and out using the roller. [Image: The keypad and dial combo can be placed right next to your keyboard. The main keypad works much like a Stream Deck, with nine customizable LCD keys that can be used to launch apps or control different features inside apps like Photoshop or Premiere Pro. There are also two page buttons at the bottom so you can create 15 pages of keys for each app. All of the controls are fully customizable through Logitech’s app, with presets you can drag and drop onto the buttons for each app. It helps automate repetitive tasks into a single button press that usually require a few clicks or memorizing numerous keyboard shortcuts. [Image: You can customize each button and key inside Logitech’s Creative Console app. While this type of hardware combination will certainly speed up creative tasks in apps, if you already have the muscle memory of knowing a variety of keyboard shortcuts then the Creative Console might be slightly less useful. The dialpad alone could make this $199.99 device worth it for some though, thanks to the dial and roller precision tools that are unlike controlling apps using a mouse or keyboard. Logitech is launching the MX Creative Console in pale grey and graphite models, and it’s even bundling three months of Adobe’s Creative Cloud membership. The main keypad connects to a PC or Mac through USB-C, and the dialpad connects via Bluetooth or Logitech’s Bolt dongle (sold separately). The MX Creative Console enters a crowded market, going up against editing consoles like the TourBox Elite, Loupedeck Creative Tool, DaVinci Resolve editing keyboards, and even Elgato’s Stream Deck. Logitech will start shipping the MX Creative Console for $199.99 on October 14th, with preorders beginning today.

articles.title: The union drive at the Wikimedia Foundation is expanding
articles.summary: US-based employees say they will file for a union election with the National Labor Relations Board.
articles.body: In June, UK staff at the nonprofit that runs Wikipedia became the first to announce their intention to form a union. Now, US-based employees at the Wikimedia Foundation are joining the union drive, but management at the nonprofit has declined to voluntarily recognize their union. “While the Wikimedia Foundation touts to the public that they plan to take a neutral stance in our organizing efforts, they have already proven that not to be the case behind the scenes,” a press release sent by Communications Workers of America, with which Wiki Workers United is affiliated, reads in part. “When the Foundation rejected our request for voluntary recognition this week, they immediately sent out to employees and the public statements couched in classic union-busting rhetoric, rhetoric undoubtedly provided by outrageously expensive union-avoidance law firms. This insulting and wasteful use of Foundation resources is both an insult to Foundation employees and to the Free Knowledge Movement as a whole.” In a public statement, the foundation said it believes a secret ballot election with the NLRB is the “appropriate path forward.” The unionization efforts come at a time when tensions are high between the foundation and the thousands of unpaid volunteers who edit, write, and maintain Wikipedia. In May, hundreds of Wikipedia editors threatened to go on strike after the foundation dissolved an engineering team that worked closely with volunteers. Some volunteers questioned whether the layoffs were related to union efforts, which the foundation denied.

articles.title: Wikipedia staffers vote to unionize.
articles.summary:
As reported by Wired, more than 200 US-based workers at the Wikimedia Foundation, which hosts Wikipedia, will join Communications Workers of America (CWA) Local 9415 after management declined to voluntarily recognize the union in July.
Organizing committee member Bryan Davis called it a “huge milestone” and said:
> We continue our petition for recognition in the U.K. and hope to see more jurisdiction-specific units call for voluntary recognition in the coming weeks and months. Solidarity will continue to drive our discussions, planning, and actions as we begin working on our collective goals for contract bargaining to support all WMF workers regardless of legal jurisdiction, job duty, or hours of employment.

articles.title: Ocasio-Cortez calls focus on Hasan Piker 'absolutely ludicrous' as some Democrats demand distance
articles.summary: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez called it "ludicrous" that Congress is focused on Twitch streamer Hasan Piker as Democrats debate his political influence.
articles.body: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, D-N.Y., brushed off far-left streamer Hasan Piker's role in American politics on Thursday, questioning why people were focused or devoting time to him. "It is absolutely ludicrous that so much oxygen from sitting elected officials in the United States Congress is being dedicated to discourse around a Twitch streamer for young people," Ocasio-Cortez, a member of the progressive Squad, said according to The Hill. Rep. Pramila Jayapal, D-Wash., also didn't dismiss him outright, telling the outlet she wouldn't defend all his views. MICHIGAN DEMOCRAT DEMANDS REPORTERS STOP ASKING 'ABOUT HASAN PIKER' AHEAD OF SENATE RACE "That's for him to do," Jayapal said. "I don’t know why, all of a sudden, the standard is you have to agree with everything he said." HASAN PIKER IS BECOMING THE 'FACE OF THE PROGRESSIVE MOVEMENT,' FORMER DEMOCRATIC OPERATIVE WARNS Jaypal told the outlet Democrats needed to reach Piker's voters. "I think that we have been talking about how we need to reach out to all parts of our party and also how difficult it is sometimes to get people to pay attention to politics, and, so, streamers are important in that," Jayapal said. The Hill cited multiple Democrats who have dismissed Piker, including Rep. Josh Gottheimer, D-N.J., who told the outlet, "Not only should people not be on stage with him or take his support, they should condemn his views and what he has said. "And I think anything short of that is unacceptable." SOME DEMOCRATS PRIVATELY DISGUSTED BY HASAN PIKER BUT ARE AFRAID TO PUBLICLY CRITICIZE HIM, HOUSE DEM CLAIMS Piker has campaigned with several Democrats this midterm election cycle, including Abdul El-Sayed, who is running for Senate in Michigan. Other Democrats have expressed the importance of reaching Piker's listeners, including Sen. Bernie Sanders, I-Vt. Sanders was asked about Piker's past statements on 9/11, which the streamer has since walked back. Sanders condemned the comments and told CNN in August, "He has a whole lot of followers and a lot of things that he's saying that are making sense to a lot of people. I think, you know, we have to get above cancel culture. You know, when you're doing radio, whatever they do, podcasts three hours a day, you say dumb things." ABDUL EL-SAYED PLAYS DOWN HASAN PIKER TIES AFTER STREAMER’S VIRAL ANTISEMITISM FIRESTORM Speaking to Stephen A. Smith during his show, "Straight Shooter," El-Sayed said this week he was trying to reach Piker's listeners. "What I'm saying is there are 3 million people who listen to Hasan," El-Sayed said. "I want to offer them a pathway into an electoral movement where, rather than sit outside of the electoral system, they see a pathway around the things that they agree with that he says that I agree with and a pathway that disavows the things that I disagree with. And, so, it's important." Smith summarized El-Sayed's strategy as an effort to win over Piker's audience rather than an endorsement of the streamer personally. "So, you're not thinking about him. You’re not thinking about him. You’re thinking about the 3 million people that support him, and you're trying to get those votes. That's what you're saying?" Smith said. DEM CANDIDATE ERUPTS IN PROFANE DEFENSE OF HASAN PIKER AS PARTY FIGURES DISTANCE THEMSELVES "Exactly," El-Sayed said. Fox News Digital reported last week that El-Sayed attempted to put distance between his campaign and Piker after the streamer faced backlash over comments about American Jews and Israel. Piker endorsed El-Sayed and appeared at multiple campaign events, including his primary night gathering. Democratic strategist Kaivan Shroff told Fox News Digital in a statement, "A lot of these folks are being rather disingenuous. Yes, media is running wild, arguably disproportionately so, with this Piker story, but a big reason for that is El-Sayed’s hard to understand refusal to create more distance between himself and the streamer or just flat disavow him. "You can’t have it both ways. Either he is just some random streamer or he is a critical figure for the left’s political movement. His refusal to … denounce him suggests the latter, though strategically it seems Piker is more of a liability than a help. Recent polling showed the vast majority of Democrats don’t like him." Schroff said Democrats like him have been consistent in calling out President Donald Trump for "dining with Nick Fuentes and bringing Laura Loomer into his inner circle." "And the reason certain candidates do have the burden to disavow Piker is not because he is some influencer who boosts them. … They have actively sought him out, campaigned with him and joined his streaming platform," he added. "Normal Democrats do not want to be associated with the insane things Piker has said." "AOC, Bernie Sanders and Abdul El-Sayed rolled out the red carpet for Hasan Piker, but now that voters are catching on to how insane his views are, they've developed a sudden case of amnesia," RNC spokesman Max Lippel told Fox News Digital in a statement. "Piker has always been an America-hating extremist, and if they didn't want to answer for his disgusting views, they should have never requested he campaign with them to begin with." CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE OF MEDIA AND CULTURE The account then followed up with a post calling Piker "our Twitch streamer." CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP Fox News' CJ Womack contributed to this report.

articles.title: WWE SmackDown live results (Sept. 4): Updates, grades for tonight's CM Punk vs. Johnny Gargano title match
articles.summary: "WWE SmackDown" heads to Cleveland for the in-ring return of Johnny Gargano for a big world title shot against CM Punk. Follow tonight's live results and play-by-play of the action here.
articles.body: "WWE SmackDown" is in Cleveland on this Friday, Sept. 4, headlined by a surprise CM Punk vs. Johnny Gargano world title match. For Gargano, the match is his first since April. Follow tonight's "WWE SmackDown" live results and play-by-play of the action here. Gargano has been sporadically planking ever since his longtime best frenemy, Tommaso Ciampa, left WWE for AEW in January. Then, in April, it became his entire gimmick, where he'd be seen exclusively in backstage segments with others speaking around him. Sami Zayn became the most prominent figure to console and relate to Gargano, seemingly setting up Gargano's eventual rise when Zayn became champion. Instead, Gargano gets a huge match in his home city. He and CM Punk have never wrestled each other before.Tag-team action will also be on display in both the men's and women's divisions, starting with the WWE debut of Kyoki (formerly NJPW's Hiromu Takahashi). The Japanese superstar debuts alongside Shinsuke Nakamura to form the Bakusai team and take on The Miz & Kit Wilson. After that, Charlotte Flair and Tatum Paxley take on the Women's Tag Team Champions, Fatal Influence, in a non-title match.Nia Jax and Tiffany Stratton will also rekindle their old rivalry in a singles match, while Giulia and Blake Monroe are scheduled once again for a match.Check out Friday night's full "WWE SmackDown" lineup below, which starts at 8 p.m. ET on USA Network:WWE Championship: CM Punk (c) vs. Johnny GarganoNia Jax vs. Tiffany StrattonBakusai (Shinsuke Nakamura and Kyoki) vs. The Miz & Kit WilsonBlake Monroe vs. GiuliaCharlotte Flair and Tatum Paxley vs. Fatal Influence (Fallon Henley and Lainey Reid)For complete coverage of tonight's "WWE SmackDown" on USA Network, follow along with Uncrowned's live blog below:

articles.body: Uncrowned has Andy Ruiz Jr. vs. Damian Knyba live results, round-by-round updates, ring walks and start time for the Ruiz vs. Knyba fight card on Friday night at Prudential Center in Newark, New Jersey. Former unified heavyweight champion Andy Ruiz Jr. returns from a two-year layoff to face Damian Knyba in the latest edition of DAZN and TNT's "The Fight" series.Ruiz (35-2-1, 22 KOs) returns to the ring for the first time since fighting Jarrell Miller to a majority draw in August 2024. The 36-year-old famously stopped Anthony Joshua in 2019 to capture the WBA, IBF and WBO unified heavyweight titles. Under new promoter Eddie Hearn's Matchroom, the Mexican-American is working back toward title contention.Knyba (17-1, 11 KOs) lost his undefeated record to current WBC heavyweight champion Agit Kabayel for the WBC interim title this past January. A popular Pole now based in New York, Knyba will be fighting on home turf on the East Coast on Friday.In the night's co-feature, recent title challenger Austin "Ammo" Williams (20-2, 13 KOs) takes on Vito Mielnicki Jr. (23-1, 13 KOs) in a battle of top-ranked American middleweights.The Ruiz vs. Knyba fight card starts at 8 p.m. ET on TNT and DAZN, with main event ring walks expected at around 11 p.m. ET.Follow all of the action with Uncrowned's live results and play-by-play of the main card below.Main card (8 p.m. ET, DAZN and TNT)Heavyweight: Andy Ruiz vs. Damian KnybaMiddleweight: Vito Mielnicki Jr. vs. Austin WilliamsLightweight: Alan Chaves vs. Eridson GarciaSuper featherweight: Zaquin Moses vs. Angel Antonio ContrerasPrelimsSuper featherweight: Dennis Thompson vs. Jose CasillasSuper welterweight: Kahshad Elliott vs. Jean Pierre ValenciaLightweight: Brooke Mullen vs. Bria MillerSuper lightweight: Jordan Simpson vs. Michael McDonald

articles.title: College football Week 1 games, scores, live updates: Oklahoma, Miami and USC all in action on Friday night
articles.summary: No. 7 Miami, No. 10 Oklahoma and No. 14 USC will all be in action on Friday night.
articles.body: Week 1 features five days of college football and the action continues Friday night with several of the sport's juggernauts back on the field.We had plenty on Thursday night with Coach Prime and Colorado eking out a win over Georgia Tech, so what's in store on Friday? There are eight FBS games, but most of the focus will be on No. 7 Miami, No. 10 Oklahoma and No. 14 USC.Darian Mensah makes his debut for Miami on the road against Stanford, which is already in the win column after a Week Zero win over Hawai'i. Oklahoma is a massive favorite in its home opener against UTEP, while USC will be looking for its second win of the young season at home against Fresno State (let's hope Trojan fans show up this time).Here are the P4 games on tap Friday night:Indiana State vs. Purdue, 7 p.m. ET (BTN)UTEP vs. No. 10 Oklahoma, 8 p.m. ET (SECN)Long Island vs. Kansas, 8 p.m. ET (ESPNU)Toledo vs. Michigan State, 9 p.m. ET (FS1)No. 7 Miami vs. Stanford, 9 p.m. ET (ESPN)Fresno State vs. No. 14 USC, 9 p.m. ET (Fox)Follow all of Friday's action with highlights, analysis and more below.

articles.title: College football Week 1 games, scores, how to watch: Boise State vs. Oregon, Clemson vs. LSU and more
articles.summary: Will Kiffin's LSU tenure get off to a good start? How will Boise State fare on the road at Oregon? Week 1's Saturday slate looks like a good one.
articles.body: We've had Week 1 appetizers on Thursday and Friday night. Now it's time to get into the meat of opening weekend with a full day of action on Saturday.The day kicks off early with two Big Ten juggernauts back on the field as defending champ Indiana hosts North Texas and No. 1 Ohio State welcomes Ball State to the Horseshoe. We'll also get an early first look at new Alabama starting QB Keelon Russell as the Crimson Tide play East Carolina.Things pick up a bit more in the afternoon window as Georgia, Tennessee and Texas all begin their seasons. But the spotlight will be on Eugene, Oregon, as the No. 2 Ducks play host to Boise State. The Broncos are the Group of Six playoff pick for many of the sport's pundits.Then Death Valley (LSU version) will take center stage as Lane Kiffin and Co. take on Clemson in the evening's marquee matchup. Will Kiffin's LSU tenure get off to a good start, or will Dabo Swinney's Tigers ruin his debut?Follow all of the action with highlights, analysis and more below.

articles.title: F1 Italian Grand Prix live updates: Kimi Antonelli becomes first Italian to win at Monza in 60 years
articles.summary: A Mercedes 1-2 highlighted this year's Italian Grand Prix.
articles.body: From 19th to first, Mercedes’ points leader Kimi Antonelli put on a show in his home country, becoming the first Italian to win at Monza since 1966. Teammate George Russell finished second, while Red Bull’s Max Verstappen rounded out the podium. It was a much less happy ending for the home team, as Ferrari’s Lewis Hamilton came in sixth and Charles Leclerc didn’t finish after crashing on the third lap. Antonelli increased his drivers’ championship lead to 66 points.Catch up on all of the race action below:

articles.title: WWE Sunday Night's Main Event live results: Updates, grades, start time for Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton
articles.summary: Follow WWE Sunday Night's Main Event live results and match updates for Sunday's event in Atlanta. The card features two major clashes: Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton and Oba Femi vs. Bron Breakker.
articles.body: Uncrowned has WWE Sunday Night's Main Event live results, match updates, grades, highlights and start time for Sunday's event at the State Farm Arena in Atlanta, Georgia. For the first time ever, WWE shifts its classic Saturday Night's Main Event show to Sunday, giving it the appropriately and obviously named Sunday Night's Main Event.The four — potentially five — match card features two heavyweight clashes. The main event is set to feature a rematch between WrestleMania 42 foes Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton. Orton returned last month at SummerSlam to attack Rhodes and cost him his match against CM Punk for the Undisputed WWE Championship. For the better part of two decades, Rhodes and Orton have been linked together as legacy (pun intended) WWE stars. Sunday marks the next chapter in their long-running story.On the “Raw” side, two of WWE's brightest young talents meet as Oba Femi takes on Bron Breakker. Femi has been the undeniable breakout star of 2026 in WWE, having won the King of the Ring tournament and retiring Brock Lesnar at SummerSlam last month. Femi's rise has irked Breakker, which spawned this rivalry in recent weeks.Much like the last SNME, back in July, there’s a celebrity element to the show, as rapper Lil Yachty faces U.S. Champion Baron Corbin in a match that, if it lasts five minutes, will earn Trick Williams a title shot later that night. Georgia-native Quavo is also advertised for the show.Here's a look at the full WWE Sunday Night's Main Event card, which airs live at 8 p.m. ET on Peacock:Cody Rhodes vs. Randy OrtonOba Femi vs. Bron BreakkerCharlotte Flair, Alexa Bliss and Tatum Paxley vs. Jade Cargill, Michin and B-FabBaron Corbin vs. Lil Yachty — Lil Yachty needs to survive five minutesUnited States Championship match: Baron Corbin (c.) vs. Trick Williams (if necessary)For complete coverage of WWE Sunday Night's Main Event, follow along with Uncrowned's live blog below:

articles.title: Outnumbered: The IAF pilot who took on four Pakistani Sabres and helped save Calcutta
articles.summary: News News: The morning of September 7, 1965, brought one of the more remarkable air battles of the war to the skies over Kalaikunda, and at its heart was Flight .
articles.body: The morning of September 7, 1965, brought one of the more remarkable air battles of the war to the skies over Kalaikunda, and at its heart was Flight Lieutenant Alfred Cooke, whose outnumbered Hunter took on four Pakistani Sabres and lived to tell an extraordinary tale. It came just hours after Kalaikunda had already been mauled once that morning, when five Sabres led by Squadron Leader Shabbir Syed struck the airbase, catching it completely off guard and destroying two Canberra bombers along with four Vampires on the ground.Buoyed by that success of this air raid, the Pakistan Air Force made the same mistake the IAF had made earlier over Sargodha, sending in a second raid against a target that was now fully alert. At around 10:30 am, radar officer Squadron Leader "Mama" Sahni picked up a fleeting blip near Port Canning and immediately alerted Kalaikunda air base. Two Hunters flying Combat Air Patrol some 60 miles north of the base, piloted by Flight Lieutenant Alfred Cooke and Flying Officer SC Mamgain, both of 14 Squadron (which now flies Jaguars), were asked to return to defend the base and arrived over Kalaikunda at 4,000 feet, at the altitude needed to intercept the four incoming low flying Sabres led by Flight Lieutenant Haleem of the 14 Squadron of the PAF.What followed was a chaotic, low-level dogfight witnessed by cheering students of IIT Kharagpur watching from their rooftops. On spotting the Hunters, the Sabres split, two engaging Cooke head-on while the other pair peeled off toward the airfield. Cooke later admitted he remembered little beyond Sabres seemingly everywhere, but his gun camera film tells a remarkable story, he fired on four different Sabres and hit three of them. The first broke up in mid-air, killing Flight Lieutenant Afzal Khan. Cooke damaged a second and third Sabre, then latched onto a fourth, chasing it relentlessly through low-level breaks and turns until he ran out of ammunition, yet stayed on its tail anyway, rattling the Pakistani pilot enough to force him off his attack run and all the way back to the border.Those watching from the ground, reported seeing two Sabres go down, a claim partly corroborated by police reports of a smoking jet and a pilot ejecting near the border. Pakistan admitted losing one Sabre, flown by Flight Lieutenant Tariq Habib, that limped back too damaged to salvage, matching the aircraft visible in Cooke's own gun camera footage. Despite the PAF's gamble to press its advantage, Kalaikunda stayed operational for the rest of the war.

articles.title: WWE Raw results, grades (Sept. 7): Liv Morgan survives Stephanie Vaquer; Bloodline gets set ablaze
articles.summary: Here's everything that went down in Birmingham, Alabama, at the Legacy Arena on Monday.
articles.body: "WWE Raw" was in Birmingham, Alabama, at the Legacy Arena on Monday. After Sunday Night's Main Event’s showcase, not much progression occurred down south.Judgment DecadeDetermining where to start with tonight’s "Raw" is difficult. It was largely chaotic in a messier way than it was productive. But, in the end, Liv Morgan stood tall once again over Stephanie Vaquer as Women’s World Champion. After a better match than their WrestleMania encounter, though, it ended the same as every Judgment Day match ever: With a lazy and nonsensically tired interference finish.Words can no longer describe how beyond over this we are.WOW 🤯@YaOnlyLivvOnce takes advantage of the chaos at ringside and RETAINS the Women's World Title! pic.twitter.com/Q2AakLqnRI— WWE (@WWE) September 8, 2026 While an interference finish wasn't surprising, Morgan retaining the Women's World Title was. WWE is set to embark on a South American tour in the coming weeks, which includes a stop through Vaquer's home of Chile. So, you would’ve thought she'd be holding gold on home soil, but perhaps we can still see that with her getting redemption in some form in a home game rather than before it.Somehow, Becky Lynch will be involved, too, as WWE heavily teased her helping Vaquer win in a pre-match encounter with Morgan. Instead, Lynch chased off the wrong stable member, which ultimately allowed for Morgan to capitalize.Tonight was only the second defense of Morgan's dreadful title reign since April, when she first won the strap. Everything Judgment Day needs to end or be drastically refreshed as soon as possible.There is NO love lost between @YaOnlyLivvOnce and @BeckyLynchWWE 😬 pic.twitter.com/6LaX7gs7FI— WWE (@WWE) September 8, 2026 A Full VisionThe Vision has never been fuller with its current five-person lineup of Bron Breakker, Bronson Reed, Logan Paul, Austin Theory and Maxxine Dupri. That doesn't mean that it shouldn't still dissolve, though.The combination of these five characters realistically is doing nothing but hurting everyone involved, minus maybe Paul, who is what he is at this stage. But regarding Theory, he's the chump of this group, and it's essentially been on full display since shortly after he joined. In recent appearances, he's taking all the damage or struggling to beat jobbers like Otis — whom he technically didn't beat Monday night, as Reed gave Otis a DQ win over Theory by interfering and attacking Otis. You know, the classic Vision finish.The Vision DECIMATES Otis and Tozawa 😳 pic.twitter.com/gVg6lk4la5— WWE (@WWE) September 8, 2026 As for Breakker, he's being weakened by needing help to hang with Oba Femi — the real untouchable star. No one believes they're on the same level, as we're supposed to, when Breakker literally needed Reed's help two nights in a row to take out Femi.The byproduct of that is also making Femi look slightly weaker after what we saw him endure against Lesnar. The layers WWE has attempted to build between all of these pieces are not cohesive anymore — if they ever were. The sad part is they very easily can be, which means keeping forces like Reed and Breakker in their own lanes rather than teamed together in one.OBA FEMI IS PISSED 😤The Ruler wants REVENGE!! pic.twitter.com/1N3hwGn9AG— WWE (@WWE) September 8, 2026 NUMBERS GAME 😬The Vision take Oba Femi down...for now! pic.twitter.com/fZeAuBu9oe— WWE (@WWE) September 8, 2026 And because of how all these elements are colliding, you can almost assuredly bet your bottom dollar that Breakker's entry in the Money In the Bank ladder match will be moot, since Femi should undeniably cost him now.BRON BREAKKER QUALIFIES! 💪@bronbreakkerwwe pic.twitter.com/j06IFml4IP— WWE (@WWE) September 8, 2026 😨 Murder Request of the NightSpringboarding off The Vision's antics on "Raw," Paul Heyman didn't perform the vaunted "Attempted Murder of the Night" on a WWE program. But he did make a blatant request for it — if Reed and Breakker didn't do enough earlier.Tonight's Oba Femi beatdown by The Vision was NOT enough for @HeymanHustle 😨 pic.twitter.com/e6A37Vagx6— WWE (@WWE) September 8, 2026 It's Bayley!So, Bayley, after having not been seen since her last appearance in a match against Lyra Valkyria, played a part in the finish of tonight’s women's Money In the Bank qualifier match, preventing Valkyria from winning to give Sol Ruca a Sol Snatcher finish.BAYLEY IS HERE!!! 😱@itsBayleyWWE pic.twitter.com/lCYgu9RnG1— WWE (@WWE) September 8, 2026 It was the best match of the night, but the booking was all wrong here. From a freshness perspective, it would’ve been amazing to see Bayley leave WWE for AEW. That could very well still happen, as she hasn't been confirmed to have re-signed yet, but keeping her tied to Valkyria is no longer interesting. We've seen them together enough now and what more they can do is beyond me.On top of that, Valkyria was refreshed with her heel turn that came at the expense of Bayley. The win over Bayley is all she's had since, displaying a terrible misstep with someone who should have been in — if not won — the women's Money In the Bank match. And the winner Monday night, Ruca, should have been in the match, too. Booking them in the same qualifier was wrong.Hopefully, this all just leads to Bayley having negotiated a much brighter role for her immediate future, because the last year and a half or so had minimal hits.BAYLEY TIME 🤌@itsBayleyWWE with PAYBACK on her mind but Lyra Valkyria BARELY escapes!!! pic.twitter.com/jBuDYgsuoP— WWE (@WWE) September 8, 2026 Gang WarsAs I said in recent weeks, Roman Reigns' part-timer schedule while holding the World Heavyweight Championship is severely hampering this show. Everything involving the Bloodline felt entirely delayed because of it.The Usos were teasing hunting down OTM and Royce Keys — now named 946 — all night while Jacob Fatu told them to slow their role. Then, at the end of the night, 946 presumably beat up security guards outside before lighting the Bloodline's car on fire.It felt like something that was supposed to have a similar effect to the famous burning of Swerve Strickland's house in AEW. It absolutely did not, though, and fell entirely flat as a show-closing angle. Keys also still hasn't explained his attack on Solo Sikoa and LA Knight, who are just suddenly absent from this whole thing — at least on Monday night.946 just set The Bloodline's car on FIRE 🔥This is FAR from over!!! pic.twitter.com/ZEzIQLVDXW— WWE (@WWE) September 8, 2026 The "Raw" Rambles:Ala-boo-ma. The Birmingham crowd was absolutely awful. Like, we're talking worst-of-the-year-caliber. There were big moments in the title match when the fans were dead silent on the near-falls. It was just lifeless in that arena.Celebrity Era, Part 2. Some dude named Matt Matthews was in the crowd and received a brief interview before he was beat up by The Miz and Kit Wilson — then Breakker too, once he arrived for his match. Not a soul in the world asked for this. Well, maybe Matthews' worst of enemies, I guess.UNCALLED FOR 😟@mikethemiz and @KitWilson_PD make an example out of Alabama native @matt_mathews! pic.twitter.com/K3NQk4HJvP— WWE (@WWE) September 8, 2026 Stuck in the Back. I mentioned Knight and Sikoa. You know, two of the literal most over wrestlers in the company right now. Well, they were relegated to one short interaction segment backstage tonight. No wonder the crowd never got off its feet.I give this "Raw" a crown score of: 2.5/10 👑WWE Raw full card results and match grades:Women's World Championship: Liv Morgan (c.) def. Stephanie Vaquer — 👑 3.25/5 👑Joe Hendry def. JD McDonagh — 👑 1/5 👑Women's Money In the Bank Qualifier: Sol Ruca def. Lyra Valkyria, Maxxine Dupri — 👑 3.5/5 👑Men's Money In the Bank Qualifier: Bron Breakker def. Ethan Page, Rey Mysterio — 👑 3/5 👑Otis def. Austin Theory — 👑 2/5 👑Recap "WWE Raw" with Uncrowned's live blog:

articles.title: College football scores, results: SMU holds off Florida State to win on late FG after long delay at start of game
articles.summary: Week 1 wrapped up with SMU pulling out a narrow win over Florida State.
articles.body: Week 1 wrapped up Monday with an ACC showdown in Tallahassee that didn't disappoint despite a late start as No. 19 SMU held off Florida State for a 27-24 win.The game was delayed more than 90 minutes due to a power outage. Per ESPN's broadcast, a transformer blew as the power was trying to be restored to the stadium. What was set to be a very brief delay stretched out well over an hour as players from both teams went back to their locker rooms.But when they were finally on the field, it was a show — albeit one that featured a lot of head-scratching mistakes. The Mustangs constantly kicked themselves in the foot and gave the Seminoles several chances to stay in the game despite an offense that was nearly unstoppable with Kevin Jennings at the helm. The star QB threw for a career-high 430 yards and three touchdowns — but also accounted for two of SMU's four turnovers.The Mustangs were one of the favorites in the ACC and are capable of getting back to the playoff for the second time in three seasons with a healthy Jennings, but they have plenty to clean up after Monday's win.For Florida State, the result is a bitter pill. The Seminoles were in the game late despite a stunning lack of defense and not much output from Ashton Daniels and its offense. It'll put even more pressure on FSU coach Mike Norvell, who was roundly booed for his decision-making and when he was shown on the video board to the home crowd at Doak Campbell Stadium. See how it all played out below with highlights, analysis and more.

articles.title: How to stream safely while traveling outside the US
articles.summary: A VPN encrypts your connection on hotel, airport and café Wi-Fi abroad, but streaming catalogs and live sports access still depend on provider rules.
articles.body: Traveling abroad used to mean leaving your normal entertainment routine at home. Now, your streaming subscriptions can come with you. However, hotels, airports and cafés often mean unfamiliar Wi-Fi networks and different streaming catalogs. If you want to stream safely while traveling outside the U.S., a VPN, or virtual private network, can help. It creates an encrypted connection between your device and the VPN server. That adds useful protection when you are on a network you do not control. A VPN can also let you choose a server in your home country. That can be useful when you sign in to streaming services you already use. Still, content availability depends on the service, your subscription and local licensing rules. Here's what to know before you travel so you can protect your connection, stream more smoothly and avoid surprises along the way. Missed CyberGuy LIVE? Watch the Protect Your Money replay Our free CyberGuy LIVE class, Protect Your Money From Today’s Biggest Threats, has ended, but you can still watch the full replay and download our financial protection checklist. Kurt "CyberGuy" Knutsson walks you through five simple ways to help defend yourself against AI scams, fraud, identity theft and financial hacks. You’ll learn how to set up bank alerts, strengthen your account logins, protect your phone number, freeze your credit and help secure your retirement savings against unauthorized transfers. No technical experience is needed. Get the free replay and checklist now at CyberGuyLive.com INSTANTLY UPGRADE YOUR STREAMING: AT HOME AND WHEN TRAVELING Why public Wi-Fi deserves extra caution Free Wi-Fi makes travel easier. Yet you often do not know who runs the network, how it is configured or who else is connected. Most major websites and apps already use HTTPS encryption. Even so, a VPN adds another encrypted tunnel between your device and the VPN server. That can reduce what the local network can learn about your internet activity. This protection is useful beyond streaming. You may check email, book a reservation or sign in to an account while you are away. Turning on a VPN before using unfamiliar Wi-Fi adds another layer of privacy. Of course, a VPN does not make every public network risk-free. You should still avoid suspicious Wi-Fi names, keep your devices updated and use strong account security. Keeping up with your usual streaming services abroad Streaming can get more complicated when you cross international borders. A service may offer one catalog in the U.S. and another in Europe or Australia. Licensing agreements, regional rights and company policies often determine what appears. A VPN can be useful here because it gives you a secure way to connect to the internet while you sign in to subscriptions you normally use at home. You can also choose a VPN server in the U.S. when you need a U.S.-based connection. However, a VPN does not guarantee access to a particular show, movie, channel or sporting event. Streaming companies set their own terms of use and regional availability rules. A program you watch at home may therefore be unavailable at your destination. Before you travel, check your streaming provider's current policies and the availability of anything you especially want to watch. Watch U.S. TV online in 3 easy steps If you want a secure U.S. connection while traveling, set everything up before you leave. That way, you are not troubleshooting from an airport lounge or hotel room. Step 1: Sign up for a VPN Choose a reputable VPN service and create your account before your trip. Look for one that offers U.S. server locations, apps for the devices you use and enough simultaneous connections for the people traveling with you. Step 2: Download the latest VPN app Install the VPN app on every phone, tablet or computer you plan to bring. Then, sign in and test the connection before you leave home. This also gives you time to solve any password, installation or account problems while you still have a reliable connection. Step 3: Connect to a VPN server in the U.S. Open your VPN and choose a U.S. server location. Once connected, open your streaming service and sign in normally. Websites and streaming services see the VPN server's IP address instead of your usual public IP address, while the connection between your device and the VPN server remains encrypted. Your streaming provider still decides what programming your account can access. TRAVEL MISTAKE PUTS PHONE, LAPTOP AND STREAMING ACCOUNTS AT RISK What U.S. TV can you watch with a VPN? Streaming services have their own rules for VPN connections, regional access and travel. Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, Amazon Prime Video, YouTube, ESPN and Apple TV+ may handle VPN connections differently, so check your service before you travel. The exact shows, movies, channels and sporting events you can watch also depend on your subscription and the streaming provider's regional rules. That is especially important for live TV and sports. Broadcast rights can change by country, league and even individual event. If there is something specific you want to watch during your trip, check the service before you leave. Streaming U.S. sports while you travel A VPN can also protect your connection while you watch live sports through subscriptions you already have. That can be useful for football, basketball, baseball, hockey, tennis, cycling, golf and other events when you are away from home. However, a VPN does not create a subscription or eliminate a provider's blackout rules. Your streaming service still controls access based on your plan, location and its current broadcasting agreements. For that reason, check the event and service before relying on it for a big game. Set everything up before you leave The best time to prepare is before you are standing in an airport with spotty Wi-Fi. Download the VPN app on your phone, tablet or laptop. Sign in and test it. Also, update your streaming apps before departure. Next, sign in to the services you expect to use. Some platforms may ask you to verify your identity when they detect a new device or location. Handling that at home can save time later. If your service supports offline viewing, download a few shows or movies before you go. Offline downloads are especially useful on planes, trains and trips where the connection may be unreliable. Choosing a VPN server for streaming When you use a VPN, your traffic travels through the VPN server before reaching the internet. Distance can affect performance. If you mainly want extra privacy and do not need a particular country, choose a nearby server. A shorter distance can often improve speed and latency. If you need a U.S. IP address for a service you normally use at home, connect to a U.S. server instead. If the stream slows down, try another server in the same country. A different location may have less congestion or better performance. What to do if your stream is buffering Not every streaming problem comes from the VPN. Hotel and airport networks can slow down when many people share the same connection. First, check the underlying Wi-Fi. Then, reconnect to the VPN or try another server. Closing apps that are downloading files, backing up photos or running large updates can also help. If the connection still struggles, lower the video quality. HD and 4K video require much more bandwidth than standard-definition video. A trusted mobile connection may also perform better than crowded public Wi-Fi, depending on your roaming plan and signal strength. THE TRICK TO SMOOTHER STREAMING AT HOME AND ON THE ROAD Streaming on Apple TV, Fire TV and Roku Traveling with a streaming device can make a hotel room feel more like home. However, VPN setup varies depending on the device. Apple TV: Some VPN providers offer dedicated Apple TV apps that you can install directly on supported models. Amazon Fire TV and Fire Stick: Many major VPN services offer apps for compatible Fire TV devices. Roku: Roku does not support traditional VPN apps directly. Instead, you generally need to connect it through a VPN-enabled router or another supported network setup. Before packing a streaming stick, check whether your hotel television gives you access to an HDMI port. Also, remember that some hotel networks use a browser-based login page. That can make connecting a streaming device more complicated. Why streaming catalogs change when you travel? A streaming service may license a movie in the U.S. but not in France, Australia or another country. Another broadcaster or streaming company may hold the rights there. As a result, the same account can show a different catalog after you cross a border. Live sports can be even more complicated because broadcasting rights often vary by market. That is why it helps to check availability before a trip. A VPN can protect your connection and change the location of the VPN server you connect through. However, it cannot change the licensing agreements behind a streaming service. Which VPN should you choose for travel? With so many VPN services available, I would focus on a few practical things. Look for strong encryption, an easy-to-use app, plenty of server locations and support for the devices you plan to bring. If you expect to stream while traveling, also check whether the VPN works well with the streaming services you use and offers servers in the countries you may need. A VPN encrypts the traffic between your device and the VPN provider's servers, which can add an important layer of privacy when you are using hotel, airport or café Wi-Fi. Before choosing one, check that it supports your phone, computer, tablet and any streaming devices you plan to use. You should also compare how many devices can connect at the same time, especially if you are traveling with family. I would also look closely at the provider's privacy practices, reputation and independent security audits. Free VPNs can come with limitations such as slower speeds, fewer server choices or questionable data practices, so read the privacy policy before installing one. Remember that a VPN is a privacy and security tool. You remain responsible for following the terms of your streaming provider and any applicable laws. For the best VPN software, see my expert review of the best VPNs for browsing the web privately on your Windows, Mac, Android & iOS devices at Cyberguy.com/VPN. Kurt's key takeaways Streaming abroad is much easier than it used to be. Still, I would not wait until you land to figure out your setup. Install your VPN and update your streaming apps before leaving home. Sign in ahead of time, too. Then download something for offline viewing so you have a backup when hotel Wi-Fi becomes unreliable. I also like using a VPN on unfamiliar networks because streaming is only part of what we do online while traveling. You may use the same connection for email, travel reservations and other accounts. Finally, remember what a VPN can and cannot do. It can encrypt your connection and let you select the location of the VPN server you use. It cannot promise that every show, channel or game will be available everywhere you travel. articles.title: Streamer colombiano sufre intento de robo mientras transmitía en directo en plena calle de Cali
articles.standfirst: El influencer la Piquiña puso un setup para hacer un en vivo en la calle y su seguridad frustró el robo
articles.summary: El influencer la Piquiña puso un setup para hacer un en vivo en la calle y su seguridad frustró el robo
articles.body: El streamer colombiano conocido como La Piquiña vivió momentos de tensión mientras realizaba una transmisión en vivo en una calle de Cali. El hecho, que quedó registrado en video y circuló ampliamente en redes sociales, terminó sin que el creador de contenido perdiera sus equipos ni resultara herido. La situación volvió a poner sobre la mesa los riesgos a los que se exponen influencers y streamers que llevan sus producciones a espacios abiertos, especialmente cuando utilizan computadores, monitores, cámaras, iluminación y otros elementos visibles que pueden atraer la atención de delincuentes. Según las publicaciones que difundieron el caso, La Piquiña había instalado un montaje de transmisión en plena vía pública, con equipos tecnológicos y luces, para realizar contenido en directo junto a su audiencia. En medio de la emisión, un sujeto habría intentado aprovechar la exposición de los aparatos para llevárselos. Sin embargo, el sistema de seguridad dispuesto en el lugar habría impedido que el presunto ladrón concretara el hurto. El reporte difundido en redes señala que el candado de seguridad fue determinante: al no poder desprender el equipo, el hombre perdió el equilibrio y cayó al suelo. Esa reacción frustró la acción antes de que pudiera escapar con algún objeto. El caso adquirió notoriedad porque ocurrió frente a las cámaras, mientras La Piquiña estaba conectado con sus seguidores. La transmisión convirtió un momento de entretenimiento en una escena de incertidumbre, al evidenciar lo vulnerable que puede ser un creador cuando instala equipos costosos en un entorno abierto. La principal razón por la que el presunto delincuente no logró ejecutar el robo fue la protección física de los equipos. El equipo de seguridad habría impedido que pudiera retirar rápidamente los elementos utilizados en el “setup” de transmisión. La reacción de quienes acompañaban la transmisión también habría contribuido a que la situación no escalara. De acuerdo con versiones compartidas en redes, un reportero presente en la escena logró retener al sujeto después de la caída. Más allá de la viralidad del video, el caso refleja cómo la creación de contenido en exteriores puede mezclarse con problemas cotidianos de seguridad urbana. El montaje de La Piquiña, pensado para interactuar con sus seguidores, terminó atrayendo una situación de riesgo que pudo haber terminado en pérdidas económicas o una agresión. El streamer pudo continuar sin que se reportaran daños físicos ni robo de sus pertenencias, pero el episodio deja una advertencia: la exposición digital no solo ocurre en las redes. Cuando la transmisión se hace en la calle, la seguridad debe ser parte central de la producción.

articles.title: Tech stocks today: Apple kicks off new era Wednesday, Anthropic S1 watch
articles.summary: Tech stock coverage for the week of Sept. 7.
articles.body: Tech stocks kicked off the holiday shortened weak lower on Tuesday, as the Nasdaq fell 0.14%. On Wednesday, Apple (AAPL) will enter a new era as CEO John Ternus hosts his first iPhone event at the company's headquarters in Cupertino, Calif.Ternus took over from former CEO Tim Cook on Sept. 1 and he'll have some rather large shoes to fill after Cook helped turn Apple into a $4.6 trillion behemoth.The company is widely expected to debut its first foldable iPhone during the presentation, as well as its iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models and the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4.Elsewhere, Wall Street is waiting with bated breath for Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) to publicly drop its S1 investing prospectus. The filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission will provide potential investors with their first look at the AI startup's financials and outlook, as well as more information about its data center spending.Rumors have swirled that the paperwork could come as early as this week, though more recent rumblings point to October.
